'''Johnathan Kanter''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 1999 Boca Raton tournament]] on 19 December 1999 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT/PIDAIFurther (Fett theme)]], according to Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d147">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-19-two-of-a-feather-boca-raton-fl-12-19-99d147/ two-of-a-feather-boca-raton-fl-12-19-99], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 19 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-19-two-of-a-feather-boca-raton-fl-12-19-99d147/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
